Berlin-based Data Scientist with 4 years of experience building machine learning models for national-security-related pattern and anomaly detection within the Australian Public Service. 
Recently I have taken a career break from my work in Autralia, using the time to explore research directions in AI, deepen a growing interest in data governance, AI policy, and responsible-AI frameworks, and build personal projects that renew my enjoyment of data science and AI. 
Experienced across the full pipeline: SQL, feature engineering, classification, unsupervised learning, and anomaly detection, alongside strong stakeholder engagement and data storytelling skills. 
Now looking to bring this combination of applied ML, governance experience, and hands-on curiosity to explore opportunities at the intersection of research, policy, and production machine learning.

## Experience

::: {.job-title}
**Australian Public Service**
<span class="dates">(2023 -- 2026)</span>
:::

::: {.role-title}
*Acting Senior Data Scientist (AP6), AI Engineering Team*
<span class="dates">(October 2025 -- May 2026)</span>
:::

- Built and deployed a hybrid semantic/lexical similarity search system to surface related items of interest across large volumes of operational data, later extending the approach to cluster related groups of records for national security analysts.
- Applied graph network analysis (entity-link analysis, community detection) and neural network experimentation (GNNs) to identify coordinated patterns of activity that would not surface through individual-record scoring.
- Trained and deployed models both locally and on cloud infrastructure (AWS SageMaker, AWS OpenSearch); built automated MLflow pipelines for model drift detection.
- Authored and maintained data governance and model documentation, ensuring all models and pipelines complied with departmental data governance and privacy frameworks.

::: {.role-title}
*Data Scientist, Enterprise Applications and Analytics*
<span class="dates">(July 2023 -- October 2025)</span>
:::

- Built predictive-targeting, anomaly-detection, and clustering models used operationally to support national security screening.
- Designed and shipped a gradient-boosted-tree model (LightGBM) to detect anomalies of interest in high-volume operational data — a project run independently from feature design through to handover, exceeding validation expectations set by end users and deployed across multiple teams.
- Partnered with frontline operational staff to translate domain expertise into usable model features (feature engineering).
- Built internal dashboards so stakeholders could visualise, use, and act on model outputs.
- Produced data governance documentation for multiple projects (data lineage, privacy impact considerations, model risk assessments), ensuring adherence to APS data governance and privacy policies and frameworks throughout the model lifecycle.
- Mentored 3 junior data scientists through a formal mentorship program; all 3 went on to land new roles or promotions in Data Science/Data Engineering.

::: {.role-title}
*Graduate (Data Governance & Partnerships)*
<span class="dates">(February 2023 -- July 2023)</span>
:::

- Reviewed projects across the branch for adherence to the department's data governance framework, working with project teams to identify and remediate gaps against privacy and governance policy.
- Supported the development and refinement of internal data governance documentation and review checklists.
- Coordinated meetings between the Department and internal/external stakeholders, including scheduling, agenda preparation, and taking and distributing minutes.
- Supported early-stage relationship management with partner teams as part of onboarding into the branch.

## Skills

**Modelling:** Gradient-boosted trees (LightGBM, XGBoost), anomaly detection, GNNs/graph methods, classical & deep learning classification, hybrid semantic/lexical retrieval, regression & time-series forecasting, NLP/LLM fine-tuning & RAG, recommender systems, clustering & dimensionality reduction.

**Tools:** Python (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch), SQL, FastAPI, Docker, AWS SageMaker, OpenSearch, Git, Vector Databases (ChromaDB, FAISS), MLflow, Spark.

**Governance & Other:** Data governance documentation, privacy impact & policy compliance, stakeholder collaboration, model monitoring & drift detection, data storytelling, MLOps/CI-CD, experiment design (A/B testing), technical documentation.

**Languages:** English (native), German (Learning -- A1 level)
